prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1296; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you were involved in in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road heading east. Traffic was moving slowly, and I had come to a complete stop behind a silver sedan. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car was pushed into the sedan in front of me.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: What was your speed right before the impact?

A: I was not moving. I had been stopped for a few seconds.

Q: Did you notice the vehicle behind you before the collision?

A: Not really. I was watching the light and the traffic ahead. I saw it in the mirror just before it hit.

Q: Where did you first feel pain or notice an injury?

A: My right wrist hurt almost immediately. I tried to brace myself on the steering wheel. Later at the hospital they told me it was fractured.

Q: Have you received medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes. I was seen at the emergency room, and I have an appointment with an orthopedic specialist next week. I have a cast on my wrist now.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was stopped and did nothing to cause the collision. I am still dealing with the pain and missing work because I can't drive or grip properly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
